scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @mimic/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:preview: pnpm --filter @mimic/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:prod: pnpm --filter @mimic/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env prod
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm db:migrate:preview && pnpm --filter @mimic/worker deploy:preview && pnpm --filter @mimic/web deploy:preview
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm db:migrate:prod && pnpm --filter @mimic/worker deploy:prod && pnpm --filter @mimic/web deploy:prod
